say:2:1620840001:1.text: The Hypogean unleashes a furious howl, unwilling to yield to defeat. Flames erupt, devouring her greed and sins until only ashes remain.

say:3:1620840002:1.text: You watch the flames burn with ferocity. No one knows if the Hypogean will rise again, but for now, victory is yours.

say:5:1620840003:0.text: You've defeated the Hypogean and freed the Sinister Swamp and Dungon from her oppression. It has been a rewarding journey for all of you.

say:5:1620840003:0.female: You've defeated the Hypogean and freed the Sinister Swamp and Dungon from her oppression. It has been a rewarding journey for all of you.

say:9:1620840006:1.text: You endured the Hypogean's overwhelming might as she was sealed, witnessing true horror firsthand. With this, you take another step toward becoming the ultimate warrior.
say:9:1620840006:1.source_cn: 你成功抵抗了魔王被封印时溢出的威压，见识过了真正的恐怖...

say:12:1620840008:1.text: You've mastered the art of charm, bending even a mighty snow monster to your will. Your triumph over the Hypogean has etched your name in glory.

say:13:1620840009:1.text: This adventure has ignited your creativity. One day, you will compose the epic poem that echoes throughout all of Dungon.
say:13:1620840009:1.source_cn: 从这次冒险中，你收获到了更多的灵感。假以时日，或许你真...

say:14:1620840010:1.source_cn: 不得不说，我喜欢这个结局。

say:17:1620840012:1.text: You played your part well, using magic to support your companions. From now on, you're no longer a lone wolf.
say:17:1620840012:1.source_cn: 你领悟了用魔法辅助同伴的要领，从今往后，你不必再单打独斗。

say:18:1620840013:1.text: At the moment of the Hypogean's death, you absorbed some of the mana she released, gaining insight into the deeper mysteries of the world. You are one step closer to becoming a greater mage.

say:19:1620840014:1.text: That's true! I learned so much from fighting alongside Magister Merlin!
say:19:1620840014:1.source_cn: 刚刚和梅林大人一起战斗的过程中，我的确学到了很多！
say:19:1620840014:1.male: That's true! I learned so much from fighting alongside Magister Merlin!
say:19:1620840014:1.female: That's true! I learned so much from fighting alongside Magister Merlin!

say:21:1620840015:1.text: Last but not least, it's Merlin, the Rogue.
say:21:1620840015:1.male: Last but not least, it's Merlin, the Rogue.
say:21:1620840015:1.female: Last but not least, it's Merlin, the Rogue.

say:22:1620840016:1.text: Well done for seeing through the Hypogean's true form and leading your team to a successful adventure.
say:22:1620840016:1.source_cn: 恭喜你，成功看透恶魔的真身，带领你的队伍圆满完成了这次冒险。
say:22:1620840016:1.male: Well done for seeing through the Hypogean's true form and leading your team to a successful adventure.
say:22:1620840016:1.female: Well done for seeing through the Hypogean's true form and leading your team to a successful adventure.

say:25:1620840018:1.text: All of you have earned the "Supreme Legendmaker" title! With this, the story of "Dungons & Hypogeans" comes to a perfect close!
say:25:1620840018:1.source_cn: ——冒险者们，你们成功取得了“传奇冒险家”的称号。至此...

say:27:1620840019:1.text: It's over... I'm not sure why, but I feel a bit sad...
say:27:1620840019:1.source_cn: 这就结束了……不知道为什么，我心里居然有点难过……

say:29:1620840020:1.text: I guess it's the same emptiness I always feel after finishing a page-turner.
say:29:1620840020:1.source_cn: 这就是所谓的“怅然若失”吧？每次我读到一本精彩小说的结...

say:30:1620840021:1.text: Over? Not even close! This is just one chapter in a saga, and your journey will continue in the future.
say:30:1620840021:1.source_cn: 结束？不，这只是完成了一小段冒险经历而已！在未来的故事...

say:31:1620840022:1.text: This is the charm of tabletop games! You can experience as many adventures as you like, brought to life through words and imagination!
say:31:1620840022:1.source_cn: 明白了吗？这就是桌面游戏的魅力！永无止境、无所限制的冒...

say:33:1620840023:1.text: You're right—things are definitely not over.
say:33:1620840023:1.source_cn: 你说的没错，事情还没结束呢。

say:34:1620840024:1.text: The Hypogean in the story has been defeated, but one still stands right before us...
say:34:1620840024:1.source_cn: 故事中的恶魔被打败了，但现实中的恶魔还在我们面前……

say:35:1620840025:1.text: Oh, is this about me now?
say:35:1620840025:1.source_cn: 哦，你们要开始谈论我啦。我的存在约等于在给你们那些刻板...

say:36:1620840026:1.text: Well, I'm not about to work overtime just to sit through your meeting. Please talk some sense into these kids, Little Merlin.

say:39:1620840028:1.source_cn: 跑团的故事落幕后，你们的结局也已写好，那康缇丝呢？
